description.value: The Slocan Community Library is a small, 100% volunteer-run public library serving the village of Slocan in the Slocan Valley. It offers a curated book catalogue, DVDs, audio books, and a collection with a focus on Indigenous reads, making it a genuine community hub in a rural cycling corridor. Touring cyclists passing through Slocan may find it a useful rest point for local information, though hours are limited to four partial days per week.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the library name, address (710 Harold St.), and phone number (250-355-2355), matching the OSM tags. The website content covers location, contact, memberships, team, and catalogue pages but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water access, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-relevant amenities, so all such fields default to null. The library is confirmed open with posted hours and a recent Christmas-closure notice dated 2025/2026.
concerns: Website membership page still references COVID-19 pandemic procedures, suggesting content may not be fully up to date.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a legitimate, active community institution in a rural cycling corridor, but the website provides no evidence of any cyclist-relevant amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi) needed to confirm a useful WWC listing. A site visit or direct contact would be needed to verify whether basic cycling amenities are present.

wow_evidence: Volunteer-run village library; ordinary library band.
blurb: Volunteer-run community library in the village of Slocan.
